inference: Deterministic first argmax; exact contact-state loop draws; both sides/all five serves

bootstrap.unit: whole seed including both sides and five serves

acceptance_protocol.scope: All previous paired-match/positive-margin/both-side criteria PLUS majority ordinary five-rally game wins must pass against both primary targets in each of three fresh blocks.
acceptance_protocol.paired_match_win_rate: Strictly greater than 0.5, counting drawn matches in the denominator.
acceptance_protocol.point_margin_interval: Lower endpoint of seed-cluster 95% bootstrap confidence interval strictly greater than zero.
acceptance_protocol.side_fairness: Rally wins strictly exceed rally losses separately on left and right.
acceptance_protocol.failure: Report failure or mixed evidence honestly. Do not silently select another candidate on these same holdouts.
acceptance_protocol.interpretation: These are predeclared empirical acceptance thresholds, not a proof of optimal play or a family-wise statistical guarantee.
acceptance_protocol.ordinary_match_win_rate: Strictly greater than0.5 for ordinary five-rally games, counting drawn games in the denominator, against each primary opponent in every block.
